encoder.score: log P(mutant amino acid | WT sequence with the site masked) - log P(WT amino acid | WT sequence with the site masked)
encoder.runtime: one masked WT forward row per unique site; all 20 canonical amino-acid log probabilities are read from the same row

selection.ranking_scope: percentiles are computed within the candidate set for one receptor scan

gpcr_tm_development.correction_2026_07_16: The earlier pooled values ranked development rows in receptor domains that also contained official-test rows. These corrected values compute development percentiles only inside the 82-row development split. The macro result, official-test preservation, and C5aR evidence are effectively unchanged.

selection.policy: retain as a small rank prior: after correcting the development percentile domain, it still gives a small pooled gain, changes development macro Spearman by less than 0.001, preserves official-test within-receptor ranking, and improves the independent C5aR scan

gpcr_tm_official_test.note: macro Spearman covers P29274 and P48039, the only test receptors with multiple observations

protherm_protein_disjoint_test.decision: not promoted; the rank gain did not improve RMSE over the frozen base ensemble strongly enough to justify another universal head

production_decision.primary_screening_consensus: 0.80 MPTherm delta-Tm percentile + 0.20 ESM-C masked-marginal percentile
production_decision.general_ddg: reported separately with negative values favorable
production_decision.gpcr_workbook_calibration: reported separately as an assay-specific rank diagnostic
production_decision.multiple_mutations: report both the sum of WT-context constituent log odds and a joint-context masked pseudo-log-likelihood; neither is calibrated as ddG
production_decision.limitations: masked-marginal log odds are sequence-compatibility scores, not kcal/mol, delta-Tm, expression, activity, or crystallizability
